title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
abstract: arXiv:2611.23358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). translated_title: 利用置换不变性启用选择性（PIES）保护实现基于近似存储器的二值Transformer
translated_abstract: 量化是降低Transformer内存存储、计算复杂度和功耗的有效技术，而权重的二值化对于满足这些要求至关重要。近似存储器可以进一步降低存储器的功耗，但同时也会引入错误。目前针对二值Transformer的研究主要集中于任务性能，而模型在存储器发生错误时的可靠运行尚未得到充分研究。本文首先以基于Transformer的双向编码器表示（BERT）为案例，评估了二值Transformer的可靠性。研究发现，只有在高误码率（例如BER = 5%或10%）下才会出现较大的精度损失。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的置换不变性启用选择性（PIES）方案，以极低的开销保护二值权重。该方案利用Transformer对行和列置换的不变性，将关键权重进行分组（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出利用Transformer对行列置换的不变性，设计了一种低开销的选择性保护方案（PIES），可显著提升基于近似存储器的二值Transformer在存储错误下的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) protection scheme that exploits Transformers' invariance to row/column permutations to protect critical binary weights with very low overhead, enhancing the dependability of binary Transformers running on approximate memories.
